headerDisplay:
Connect your Clipsal/Schneider Electric C-Bus lighting network to Apple HomeKit via C-Gate.

**First run:** set the C-Gate host and project, then restart. The plugin discovers every named group in your project and adds it below as a **disabled** override — nothing reaches HomeKit until you tick **Enabled** on the groups you want and restart again.

host.title: C-Gate Host
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the C-Gate server.

network.title: Default Network
network.description: Reserved. Networks are taken from the discovered address or from an override's own network/application/group, so this currently has no effect.

allowBulkRemoval.title: Allow Bulk Removal
allowBulkRemoval.description: Allow a single discovery pass to remove more than 20% of your accessories. Removal permanently destroys HomeKit room, scene and automation assignments, so leave this off unless you are deliberately decommissioning a lot of groups.

maxAccessories.title: Max Accessories
maxAccessories.description: Limit the number of accessories registered (0 = unlimited). Useful for debugging.

port.title: Commander Port
port.description: HTTP port for the C-Gate command console (0 = disabled). The console has no authentication and listens on every interface, so anyone who can reach the port can operate your lighting. Leave it at 0 unless you are debugging, and never expose it to the internet.

groupOverrides.title: Group Type Overrides

type.title: Device Type
type.description: How this group is exposed to HomeKit. Defaults to Dimmer Light, or Temperature Sensor for a measurement device (application 228).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Untick to hide this group from HomeKit. Newly discovered groups start disabled.

channel.title: Measurement Channel
channel.description: Required for temperature sensors (app 228). The measurement channel on the device, e.g. 1. Add one entry per channel you want to expose.

travelTime.title: Cover Travel Time (seconds)
travelTime.description: Time for cover to fully open/close.

autoOff.title: Switch Auto-Off (seconds)
autoOff.description: Automatically turn off switch after N seconds (0 = disabled).

rampRate.title: Dimmer Ramp Rate (seconds)
rampRate.description: Default ramp duration for dimmer changes.

groupOverrides.description: One entry per C-Bus group. The plugin fills these in for you as it discovers groups; tick Enabled on the ones you want in HomeKit and set the right Device Type.

layout.title: HTTP Commander
layout.description: Optional web console for direct C-Gate command access. Unauthenticated — leave disabled (0) unless you are debugging.

layout.title: Group Type Overrides
layout.description: Discovered groups appear here automatically, disabled. Tick Enabled and pick the right Device Type, then restart Homebridge.
